decision.justification: Selected 'trimmed_mean' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.6612. Series context: trend strength 0.9739 and seasonal strength 0.0; model ranking is moderate across windows (Kendall tau 0.548); 4 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 23.332.
